entries.name: Dumbbell Lunge
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on The circle-pair chain (spine 24.00, neck 9.00, thigh 20.00, shin 21.00 exact) per leg from the shared hip. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a dumbbell lunge.

frames.caption: Stand tall with the dumbbells at the sides and the ribs down.
Step forward far enough that the front shin stays near vertical.
Lower until the back knee hovers just off the floor.
Hold the hover with the torso tall and the front shin vertical.
Drive through the whole front foot to come back up.

entries.name: Step-up with Knee Raise
entries.reason: Redrawn on 8 October 2026 at the owner's request, because the earlier drawing contradicted this text: it showed the free leg swinging out behind and the athlete never standing tall. Source-bound side-view draft: feet together facing a box; one whole foot is placed on the top, the hip and knee extend to stand tall on the box as the opposite knee drives up, a short hold, and the motion reverses to step down. The stepping foot stays where it is placed and the floor foot does not jump. One side is shown; the last caption carries the change of legs.
entries.summary: Facing a box, place one whole foot on top, stand tall and drive the opposite knee up as high as you can, then reverse to step down and repeat on the other leg.

frames.caption: Stand facing a box or bench of a height you can control, feet together.
Step up by placing one whole foot on the top.
Extend the hip and knee to stand tall, and as you stand drive the opposite knee up as high as you can.
Stand tall before the knee comes up.
Reverse the motion to step down, under control.
Feet together on the floor again.
Repeat on the other leg.

entries.name: Barbell Step-Up
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 18 degrees so the barbell across the upper back, the whole lead foot planted on the box with the thigh near parallel at the bottom, the hanging trailing leg, and the single-leg balance over the standing foot all show clearly: driving through the top leg to stand tall on the box while the floor leg hangs, then lowering on a slower controlled count until the floor toe touches.
entries.summary: With a barbell across the upper back and the whole lead foot on a box that puts the thigh near parallel, drive through the top leg to stand tall while the floor leg hangs, then lower on a controlled count until the floor toe touches.

frames.caption: Set the bar as for a squat, stand close to a box that puts your thigh near parallel, and put the whole foot on the box.
Drive through the top leg with the chest proud to stand tall through the hip while the floor leg hangs.
Stand tall through the hip with the whole foot on the box; the bottom foot is a passenger.
Lower on a controlled count until the floor toe touches.
Touch the floor toe down without rocking and go again.

entries.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 18 degrees so both dumbbells hanging quiet at the sides, the whole lead foot planted on the box with the thigh near parallel at the bottom, the hanging trailing leg, and the single-leg balance over the standing foot all show clearly: driving through the top leg to stand all the way up while the floor leg hangs, then lowering on a slower controlled count until the floor toe touches.
entries.summary: Holding a dumbbell in each hand quiet at your sides with the whole lead foot on a box that puts the thigh near parallel, drive through the top leg to stand all the way up while the floor leg hangs, then lower on a controlled count until the floor toe touches.

frames.caption: Hold a dumbbell in each hand hanging quiet at your sides, stand close to a box that puts your thigh near parallel, and put the whole foot on the box.
Drive through the top leg to stand all the way up on the box while the floor leg hangs.
Stand all the way up on the box with the dumbbells hanging quiet at your sides and the bottom foot as a passenger.
Lower on a controlled count until the floor toe touches.
Touch the floor toe down without rocking and go again.

entries.name: Barbell Lunge
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 18 degrees so the rack behind, the barbell across the upper back, the hip-width standing stance, the forward step, and the straight-down drop of the hips with an upright torso all read clearly: stepping forward with one leg, lowering the hips straight down under control with the front knee in line with the toes, and pushing through the front heel to step back to standing.
entries.summary: With a barbell across the upper back and the feet hip-width apart, step forward with one leg and lower the hips straight down under control with the torso upright, then push through the front heel to step back to standing.

frames.caption: Take the bar from the rack across the upper back and stand clear with the feet hip-width apart, torso tall, and eyes forward.
Step forward with one leg, keeping the torso upright and the front knee in line with the toes.
Lower the hips straight down under control with the torso upright.
Push through the front heel to rise from the bottom of the lunge.
Step back to standing with the feet hip-width apart.
Complete the repetitions on one leg, then change legs.
